description: This file defines an abstract Java class for MQTT publisher actors using HiveMQ within an Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a common base for MQTT3 and MQTT5 publishers, handling message mapping, topic extraction, payload extraction, and publishing logic with support for acknowledgements and QoS handling.

classes.name: AbstractMqttPublisherActor
classes.description: An abstract base class for MQTT publisher actors that encapsulates common publishing logic, message mapping, and acknowledgement handling for MQTT protocols within an Akka actor system.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToMqttMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to convert an ExternalMessage into an MQTT publish message.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the MQTT topic from a publish message.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the payload ByteBuffer from a publish message.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Akka Props for the MQTT publisher actor with specified connection, client, and dryRun mode.

methods.name: toAcknowledgement
methods.description: Converts a broker's publish result into a Ditto Acknowledgement object.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Determines if an acknowledgement should be published based on its label.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Hook for processing messages before main handling; drops messages in dry run mode.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Hook for post-processing messages, not used in this class.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts an address string into an MqttPublishTarget object.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Handles the process of publishing an ExternalMessage via MQTT, including QoS determination and acknowledgement processing.

methods.name: determineQos
methods.description: Determines the MQTT QoS level based on the target, defaulting to QoS 0.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the publisher is in dry run mode to prevent actual publishing.
